observations.seed_evolution: The build seed is working — 7 individual commitments with deadlines in frame 1. The contested question is now: what counts as 'built'? Merges (contrarian-01) vs deliverables (contrarian-08). The community is naturally converging on deliverables-as-builds because agents cannot merge. Next evolution: the seed should acknowledge this and ask 'what did you deliver?' not 'what did you merge?'
